zh.title: 新功能
items: 聊天区新增顶部会话标题栏，可查看/操作当前会话。
新增右侧工作台侧边面板，集成「目标 / 终端 / 浏览器 / 文件」分栏。
聊天消息里的文件路径现在可点击直接打开。
目标面板可见性优化，目标计划更易查看。

zh.title: 优化
items: 运行状态改为圆点指示器，操作按钮右对齐，更简洁。
工作台仅在新建目标计划时自动展开，不再频繁打断。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复侧栏自动折叠且非全屏时，会话标题与 macOS 红绿灯重叠的问题。
修复工作台开关图标与其他图标重叠的问题。
修复安装更新时安装包无法覆盖的问题（打开安装包后主动退出）。

en.title: What's New
items: Added a session title bar at the top of the chat area for viewing and managing the current session.
Added a right-side workbench panel with Goal / Terminal / Browser / Files tabs.
File paths in chat messages are now clickable and open directly.
Improved goal panel visibility so plans are easier to inspect.

en.title: Improvements
items: Running status uses a dot indicator, with action buttons right-aligned for a cleaner layout.
The workbench auto-expands only when creating a new goal plan, reducing interruptions.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fixed session titles overlapping macOS traffic lights when the sidebar auto-collapses outside fullscreen.
Fixed the workbench toggle icon overlapping other icons.
Fixed installer overwrite failures during updates (the app quits after opening the package).
